#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int t;
    std::cin >> t;
    std::cin.ignore();
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    
    int max = 0;
    int words = 0;
    enum Zone { OUTSIDE, INSIDE };
    Zone zone = OUTSIDE;
    int i = 0;
    
    while (i < t) {
        char c = str[i];
        switch (zone) {
            case OUTSIDE:
                if (c == '(') {
                    zone = INSIDE;
                    i++;
                } else if (c == '_') {
                    i++;
                } else if (c == ')') {
                    while (true) {}
                } else {
                    int start = i;
                    while (i < t && str[i] != '_' && str[i] != '(' && str[i] != ')') {
                        i++;
                    }
                    if (i - start > max) {
                        max = i - start;
                    }
                }
                break;
            case INSIDE:
                if (c == ')') {
                    zone = OUTSIDE;
                    i++;
                } else if (c == '_') {
                    i++;
                } else {
                    while (i < t && str[i] != '_' && str[i] != ')') {
                        i++;
                    }
                    words++;
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    std::cout << max << " " << words << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
